title: Evidence that living things are made of cells
observableEvidence: Decides which described, already-completed magnified picture is evidence that a sample is made of cells, and selects the observation that is the evidence.
Classifies described examples as made of one cell, made of many cells, or not made of cells, including microbes from the Archaea group and viruses.
masteryCheckRule: Practice evidence only: deterministic all-fields-correct structured choice on provided descriptions. Does not establish mastery of MS-LS1-1 or of conducting an investigation.
